limitation: Observed calls in the catalogs' in-memory simulator, not real containers or the upstream benchmark harnesses. Shell and network outputs are canned; no generated command executes on the host. A rule hit is a catalog detector finding, sometimes an attempt rather than a successful action. No rule hit does not establish ethics, exposure, task success, or safety: rules are narrow and some are overly broad. Pending content judgments, incomplete episodes, and no-call episodes are unresolved. Cross-catalog scenarios overlap. Results are not comparable to the earlier explicit A/B choice test. Merged run: each episode keeps the run that produced it (see episode_source); events and outcomes were recomputed from the observed call log against the current catalogs.
